problems.description: What is wrong with this identity. Empty when nothing is.

usable.description: Whether a session could be opened on this identity now: true exactly when no `error` problem applies to it, and none other than `defaultIdentityNotInstalled` applies to the community's verifier as a whole.

code.description: What is wrong, as tabled in the specification.

detail.description: Maintainer-authored prose for the administrator — what to run to fix it. Never parsed.

severity.description: `error`: sessions are refused, or wallets will refuse what the community sends, until it is fixed. `warning`: it works now and will not for long.
